summary_en: Fonfun corporation will acquire all issued shares (2,000 shares) of ICS Corporation from G Holdings Corporation for cash consideration, making ICS a wholly-owned subsidiary. ICS generated revenue of ¥795.7 million and operating profit of ¥29.3 million in the year ending August 2026 (forecast).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Shares of ICS Corporation (Making it a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
On September 29, 2026, Fonfun Corporation's board of directors approved the acquisition of all issued shares of ICS Corporation (2,000 shares) from G Holdings Corporation by means of a share purchase agreement, with cash as consideration. Upon completion, ICS will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Fonfun. The acquisition has no publicly disclosed transaction amount.

ICS operates in system development and maintenance for telecommunications networks, engineer dispatching, and telecommunications base station facility construction. In the fiscal year ending August 2026 (forecast), ICS reported revenue of ¥795.7 million and operating profit of ¥29.3 million. The company holds a strong business foundation with major telecommunications carriers and construction firms, including contracted system development projects from large carriers.

Fonfun positions M&A as a key pillar of its growth strategy under its medium-term management plan "Project Phoenix II" (announced May 25, 2026), targeting market capitalization of ¥30 billion, revenue of ¥10 billion, and EBITDA of ¥2 billion by March 31, 2029. The acquisition of ICS is expected to strengthen Fonfun's recurring revenue base in the DX solutions domain through roll-up consolidation. As a precondition to the transaction, ICS will settle its outstanding loans to its parent company (¥192.8 million) before closing.
